valores.label: Gov. Tony Knowles names the east Lynn Canal highway the preferred alternative (January 2000)

fonte: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
legenda: As recounted in the Ninth Circuit opinion of May 4, 2011.
credito_tela: Source: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, 2011
nota: Decisão de tribunal federal: domínio público. Sem divergência.
narracao: In January 2000, Governor Tony Knowles picked the state's preferred option: a road up the east side of Lynn Canal. Because of its high cost, he said, he wouldn't actively pursue it while he was in office.

conferencia.prova: "In January 2000, Governor Tony Knowles announced that ADOT's preferred alternative for the Project was a plan in the draft EIS calling for the construction of a highway along the eastern side of Lynn Canal … but stated that the alternative would not be actively pursued during his administration because of its high cost."

fontes.provedor: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
fontes.documento: Southeast Alaska Conservation Council v. FHWA, No. 09-35551, Opinion (filed May 4, 2011)
